There are markings on the tail fins that look like numbers ('61', '62') but are slightly distorted and inconsistently shaped, suggesting minor text generation issues.

The texture of the hill in the foreground is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the fine detail of individual grass blades or rocks, appearing more like a painted gradient than natural terrain.
